parsed.summary: Expect working capital cycle to settle within 45 to 50 days.
parsed.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
parsed.quote: As these effects normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

parsed.summary: Maintains medium to long-term Wires & Cables EBIT margin guidance of 11% to 13%.
parsed.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
parsed.quote: Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.

parsed.summary: Targets FMEG EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.
parsed.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
parsed.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.

parsed.summary: Expects INR 800 to 1,000 crores revenue from Bharat Net in FY27.
parsed.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
parsed.quote: So we can safely say maybe 1/3rd of that should translate into revenue, maybe INR 800 crores to INR 1,000 crores may come from Bharat Net alone.

parsed.summary: Expects about INR 800 crores revenue execution from RDSS this year.
parsed.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
parsed.quote: And again, in case of RDSS, since the execution piece is around 3 years, we should expect about INR 800-odd crores translating this year.

parsed.summary: Targets exports reaching over 10% of overall top line by 2030.
parsed.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
parsed.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.

parsed.summary: Aims for full year FMEG EBITDA margin of 8% to 10%.
parsed.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
parsed.quote: And of course, the ambition is that on a full year basis, we should be able to reach 8% to 10% of EBITDA margins on FMEG.
